# RNG-002 corpus provenance

Inputs only; no expected answers generated by Rust. Reproduce and audit:
`python3 tools/oracle/extended_corpus.py --write` (writing is explicit);
`python3 tools/oracle/extended_corpus.py` checks the existing fixture unchanged.

25 cases / 13227 operations, ten seeds including all six RNG-001 seeds. Includes
all contracted bounds, long mixed chains, invalid bounds with a paired control,
and paired reseed chains for the six boundary seeds. The `rejection` case is
2048 consecutive bound=1073741825 calls starting from seed=0.

RandomExtendedOracle delegates to the actual Java API. RejectionMutation is an
explicitly synthetic subclass using the real Random.next(31) but deliberately
omitting rejection; it is never used as the reference. The audit records its
mismatches separately under artifacts/oracle-extended-check/audit.json.
All 2048 synthetic values differ from the real reference for the chosen chain.
No game/world compatibility is implied by Java API tests.
